params.topic: Copa Libertadores historical source mapping for seasons 2018 through 2025 inclusive; exclude 2026
questions: Find the authoritative CONMEBOL source pages or downloadable datasets for each Copa Libertadores season from 2018 through 2025. For each season report exact URL, source title/type, access status, retrieval time, season coverage, and whether it provides official stage/round and knockout tie/leg structure. Do not transcribe individual match rows or scorelines.

Find up to two independent structured source candidates that cover the same eight seasons. Verify competition identity and stable season/fixture identifiers from the source itself; specifically do not treat API-Football league ID 13 alone as verified source mapping. Report exact URLs and field selectors/semantics for fixture ID, season, scheduled kickoff with timezone, home/away team identity, stadium/venue, city, official stage/round, group ID, tie ID, leg, and single-match knockout marker when available.

For each season separately, summarize source-level coverage counts only when explicitly published by the source, identify season-format changes and unresolved fields/conflicts, and list the next precise verification steps needed to establish a local source mapping and per-season CSV hashes. Leave unknown counts and fields unavailable; do not estimate or fill them.
